description: Land Title Settlement Department -  Akaravita, Gampaha D/S Division, Gampaha District  - Cad. Map No. 511804 and others
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters, specifically the declaration of determinations by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding ownership of specific land parcels. It contains detailed schedules with parcel numbers, owner names, property extents, and land title classifications. The content falls under "Land and property-related matters" including "land registrations, property ownership, land titles" as defined in Type 4 (Land Gazettes).
